newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK air cargo handler's throughput up 16 pct in Nov.
newsitem.headline: HK air cargo handler's throughput up 16 pct in Nov.

text.p: Hong Kong Air Cargo Terminals Ltd (HACTL) said on Wednesday its throughput in November rose 16 percent versus the same period in 1995.
Exports climbed 18.2 percent to 78,236 tonnes, while imports rose 12.8 percent to 53,972 tonnes.
Transhipments jumped 16.6 percent to 17,861 tonnes as the territory's exporters moved into overdrive to meet heavy seasonal demand, HACTL said in a statement.

Total air cargo volume handled by HACTL during the year to November 30 stood at 1.35 million tonnes, 5.9 percent ahead of the 1.275 million tonnes registered in the first 11 months of last year, it said.

The group is 25 percent held by Jardine Matheson Holdings Ltd, 20 percent by Swire Pacific Ltd, 12.5 percent by Wharf (Holdings) Ltd, 12.5 percent by Hutchinson Whampoa Ltd and 10 percent each by CITIC Pacific Ltd, China National Aviation Corp and Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd.
